title: Fix Agent Arena add/edit property failures

requirements.text: Fix backend authorization for property create/update/delete so Agent Arena can add and edit properties successfully using only the Agent Code ("050702"), without requiring Internet Identity authentication.

quotes: failed to add and edit property error showing now fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Calling `createPropertyWithCode(params, agentCode)` with agentCode "050702" succeeds even when the caller is not authenticated via Internet Identity.
Calling `updatePropertyWithCode(propertyId, params, agentCode)` with agentCode "050702" succeeds even when the caller is not authenticated via Internet Identity.
Calling `deletePropertyWithCode(propertyId, agentCode)` with agentCode "050702" succeeds even when the caller is not authenticated via Internet Identity.
If `agentCode` is missing/incorrect for create/update/delete, the backend rejects the operation with a clear error message that includes the words "Invalid agent code" (English).
Public property browsing queries (`getAllProperties`, `getPropertyById`, and search/filter queries) remain publicly accessible without requiring any agent code.

requirements.text: Ensure the Agent Arena UI shows a clear English error message when property creation or editing fails, surfacing the backend’s returned reason (especially invalid agent code) instead of only a generic failure message.

quotes: failed to add and edit property error showing now fix it

acceptanceCriteria: When backend rejects a mutation due to an invalid/missing agent code, the UI displays an English toast/message that clearly instructs the user to return to "/agent" and enter the agent code again.

When backend rejects a mutation for non-authorization reasons (e.g., "Property not found"), the UI displays that reason in English (or a safe, readable normalized equivalent) rather than only "Failed to create property" / "Failed to update property".
The add property flow successfully creates a property and navigates back to "/agent/properties" without showing an error.
The edit property flow successfully updates an existing property and navigates back to "/agent/properties" without showing an error.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit any frontend files under immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose existing UI components instead).
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication providers or reinstating Internet Identity-based login/signup for the Agent Arena.
Changing public listings search behavior or location autocomplete behavior beyond what is required to fix add/edit failures.
UI redesign unrelated to the add/edit property error.
